title: Seroepidemiology of Enterovirus D68 in Xiamen Children: A Cross-Sectional Study in 2022
abstract: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a re-emerging pathogen associated with severe acute flaccid myelitis (AFM) and pneumonia, predominantly in children but also capable of causing severe disease in immunocompromised adults. Seroprevalence data are essential for understanding population immunity, age-specific susceptibility, and viral transmission dynamics; yet, such data for the period after the COVID-19 pandemic are scarce. We conducted a cross-sectional serological survey to characterize the neutralizing antibody profile of EV-D68 among children in Xiamen, China, in 2022. A total of 453 children aged 0–16 years (217 with acute respiratory tract infection [ARTI] and 236 without) were enrolled. Neutralizing antibody (NtAb) titers against the EV-D68 STL strain were measured using a microneutralization assay, seropositivity was defined as a titer ≥1:16. Multivariable regression and analysis of covariance were used to adjust for age and sex. Overall seroprevalence was 96.0% (435/453), exceeding 90.0% in every age subgroup (0–1 y: 100%; 1–3 y: 97.6%; 3–5 y: 92.6%; ≥5 y: 96.2%). The geometric mean titer (GMT) was 76.78 (95% CI: 68.32–85.24). After adjustment, ARTI status was not significantly associated with seropositivity (adjusted OR = 1.42, 95% CI: 0.46–4.41, p = 0.542). In an exploratory comparison, children with ARTI showed nominally higher antibody titers than those without (Mann–Whitney U test, p = 0.003), although the absence of EV-D68-specific PCR testing precludes etiologic attribution of respiratory symptoms to EV-D68 infection. Infants 90.0%) with distinct age-dependent patterns. These findings provide key reference data for ongoing serosurveillance, outbreak risk assessment, and the evaluation of future vaccines or immunoprophylactic strategies should they become available.

title: Disease burden of non-polio enterovirus-associated meningitis in children in G20 countries: an analysis based on GBD data and projections to 2050
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-polio enteroviruses (NPEVs) have emerged as the leading etiological cause of childhood meningitis globally, yet the long-term disease burden and its epidemiological trends within G20 countries remain insufficiently characterized. This study aims to systematically evaluate the burden of pediatric NPEV-associated meningitis in G20 countries from 1990 to 2023 and to project future trends to 2050. METHODS: Data were extracted from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) database. The primary outcome measures were mortality and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) due to NPEV-associated meningitis in children aged 0-14 years. Estimated annual percentage changes (EAPCs) were calculated to quantify temporal trends. Spearman's rank correlation was used to assess the relationship between disease burden and the Socio-demographic Index (SDI) across G20 countries. A Bayesian age-period-cohort (BAPC) model was employed to forecast disease burden to 2050. RESULTS: In G20 countries, the mortality rate for pediatric NPEV-associated meningitis declined from 1.153 per 100,000 (95% UI: 0.902-1.453) in 1990 to 0.088 per 100,000 (95% UI: 0.070-0.113) in 2023 (EAPC: -7.72%, 95% CI: -8.19 to -7.24). The DALY rate decreased from 107.732 to 9.487 per 100,000 over the same period (EAPC: -7.35%, 95% CI: -7.80 to -6.91). Significant age-related disparities were observed: infants younger than 1 year bore the highest burden (mortality: 0.890 per 100,000; DALY: 80.649 per 100,000), despite showing smaller relative declines compared to older children. At the national level, Indonesia had the highest mortality rate (0.374 per 100,000) and DALY rate (34.344 per 100,000)\. Notably, South Africa exhibited the slowest decline among all G20 members (mortality EAPC: -3.80%; DALY EAPC: -3.76%), far below the G20 averages. Both mortality and DALY rates showed significant negative correlations with SDI across G20 countries (r = -0.849 and - 0.832, respectively, both p < 0.001). Projections to 2050 indicate continued declines, with mortality and DALY rates decreasing by over 95% in G20 countries. CONCLUSIONS: From 1990 to 2023, the burden of pediatric NPEV meningitis in G20 countries declined significantly, yet substantial intra-G20 disparities persist. Indonesia had the highest rates, India the largest absolute numbers, and South Africa the slowest decline. Infants younger than 1 remain the most vulnerable group. Future efforts should prioritize enhanced surveillance and targeted interventions in high-burden countries including Indonesia, South Africa, and India, and strengthen diagnostic capacities in lower-resourced member states to narrow gaps within this influential group of nations.

analysis_zh.methods: 主要结局指标包括 死亡率 和 NPEV 相关脑膜炎导致的伤残调整生命年 (DALY)。计算估计年度百分比变化 (EAPC) 以量化时间趋势,斯皮尔曼等级相关性评估疾病负担与社会人口指数 (SDI) 之间的关系。使用贝叶斯年龄周期 队列研究 (BAPC) 模型预测 2050 年的疾病负担。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为G20国家过去30年NPEV相关脑膜炎负担显著下降,但各国和年龄组间差异持续存在。研究的创新之处在于采用先进建模技术对趋势进行全面量化并预测至2050年。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为印度尼西亚、南非和印度等高负担 G20 国家的针对性 监测 和干预策略提供了信息,并强调需要加强资源较低成员国的诊断能力,以减少 G20 内部的差距。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于GBD 2023数据,该数据在G20国家的案例确定和代表性方面可能存在固有的局限性。由于生态研究设计和潜在的混杂因素,时间趋势和预测的证据强度较高,但因果推断的证据强度适中。

title: EVALUATING THE MECHANISMS OF PATHOGENESIS AND ANTIBODY-MEDIATED PROTECTION IN ENTEROVIRUS D68-INDUCED ACUTE FLACCID MYELITIS
abstract: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a major cause of acute flaccid myelitis (AFM), a severe neurologic disease in children that can result in sudden paralysis and lifelong disability. Currently, no approved therapies specifically target EV-D68-associated AFM. Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) represent a promising therapeutic strategy because they combine viral neutralization through the Fab region with immune-cell recruitment through the Fc region. However, the contribution of Fc effector function to protection against EV-D68-induced neurologic disease remains unclear. This study investigated whether Fc effector function enhances protection against AFM using the partially neutralizing mAb EV68-41. Wild-type EV68-41 (EV68-41-WT), which retains Fc effector function, was compared with an Fc-deficient LALAPG variant (EV68-41-LALAPG) in an animal model of EV-D68 infection. Survival and neurologic outcomes were assessed and compared with the potently neutralizing mAb EV68-228. No significant difference in survival was observed between EV68-41-WT and EV68-41-LALAPG, with both providing approximately 60% survival. However, EV68-41-LALAPG-treated mice exhibited higher peak neurologic scores, indicating more severe limb paralysis, compared with EV68-41-WT-treated mice. In contrast, both EV68-228 variants provided 100% survival and complete neurologic protection. These findings demonstrate that Fc effector function can reduce neurologic disease severity even when it does not significantly improve survival. Together, the results suggest that effective mAb therapies for EV-D68-associated AFM should combine potent viral neutralization with Fc-mediated immune recruitment, potentially improving neurologic outcomes and reducing the burden of childhood paralysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肠道病毒 D68 (EV-D68) 会导致 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 (AFM),这是一种严重的儿童神经系统疾病,可导致突然瘫痪和终身残疾,但目前还没有批准的专门针对 EV-D68 相关 AFM 的治疗方法。该研究旨在确定单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的 Fc 效应子功能是否能增强对 EV-D68 诱发的神经系统疾病的保护作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用 EV-D68 感染的动物模型来比较部分中和单克隆抗体 EV68-41 与 Fc 缺陷型变体 (EV68-41-LALAPG) 以及强中和单克隆抗体 EV68-228。对治疗小鼠的存活率和神经系统结果进行了评估。
elements_zh.methods: 在 EV-D68 感染的动物模型中,将保留 Fc 效应子功能的野生型 EV68-41 (EV68-41-WT) 与 Fc 缺陷型 LALAPG 变体 (EV68-41-LALAPG) 进行比较。测量了存活率和神经系统结果,并与强效中和 mAb EV68-228 进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: EV68-41-WT 和 EV68-41-LALAPG 之间的存活率没有显着差异,两者均提供约 60% 的存活率。与 EV68-41-WT 治疗的小鼠相比,EV68-41-LALAPG 治疗的小鼠表现出更高的峰值神经评分,表明肢体麻痹更严重。EV68-228 两种变体均提供 100% 的存活率和完整的神经系统保护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,Fc 效应子功能即使不能显着提高生存率,也可以降低神经系统疾病的严重程度,这表明针对 EV-D68 相关 AFM 的有效 mAb 疗法应将有效的病毒中和与 Fc 介导的免疫招募结合起来。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,mAb 疗法中的 Fc 效应器功能可以改善神经系统结果,减轻 EV-D68 相关 AFM 引起的儿童瘫痪负担,为未来的治疗开发和临床策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于它依赖于动物模型,可能无法完全重现人类疾病的复杂性,并且缺乏人类临床数据。证据是中等的,因为研究结果来自特定 mAb 变体的受控实验环境。

title: Broad-spectrum host-targeting antivirals for rhinovirus infections: mechanisms and future perspectives
abstract: Rhinovirus is the main pathogen causing common colds, acute exacerbations of asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and other respiratory diseases. Due to its numerous serotypes and the lack of common conserved viral targets, the development of traditional direct-acting antiviral drugs (DAAs) faces challenges. Host-targeting antivirals (HTAs), as an emerging strategy, provide a new approach to overcome this difficulty by interfering with the host cell factors or pathways necessary for viral replication. This review systematically presents the latest progress in host-targeted rhinovirus therapy by focusing on numerous host factors involved in rhinovirus invasion, attachment, biosynthesis, assembly and release, and immune regulation. Although the prospects are broad, the clinical transformation of this strategy still faces challenges such as safety, delivery efficiency, and individual differences. In conclusion, HTAs are expected to become a transformative treatment strategy for rhinovirus infection, especially for high-risk patient groups.

title: Isolation and partial 5′UTR-based molecular characterization of bovine enterovirus F from non-diarrheic cattle in Türkiye
abstract: Bovine enteroviruses (BEVs) are widely distributed among cattle worldwide and are commonly associated with subclinical infections, although their role in enteric, respiratory, and reproductive disorders remains incompletely understood. BEVs infect cattle as their natural host and are currently classified mainly within the species Enterovirus E and Enterovirus F. The advancement of virological research conducted as part of the elimination study may be affected by the concurrent circulation of enteric viruses, including BEV, in cattle populations. During a non-cytopathogenic BVDV elimination study, cytopathogenic agents unrelated to BVDV were incidentally detected and subjected to conventional virological and molecular identification. For analysis, rectal and nasal swab samples were taken from 4 cattle showing mild respiratory symptoms on a farm, as well as blood samples from a total of 42 animals, including those that showed signs of contact. The cytopathogenic effect was detected in the Madin-Darby bovine kidney (MDBK) cell line by cultivation of fecal specimens. Two isolates were obtained and subjected to physicochemical characterization and determination of nucleic acid type. The fecal isolates were analyzed by RT-PCR using specific primers for possible key pathogens. The isolates showed resistance to chloroform and BrdU treatment, findings consistent with the characteristics of non-enveloped RNA viruses. Both isolates were positive in bovine enterovirus RT-PCR, and the molecular genetic analysis of the partial 5'UTR region of one of the isolates indicated that it belonged to the BEV-F clade. All 42 serum samples showed neutralizing activity at a dilution of ≥ 1:640 against the isolate used in the VNT. This study, based on partial 5'UTR sequence analysis, provides preliminary molecular evidence of a bovine enterovirus associated with EV-F in Türkiye. Given the limited number of studies conducted in Türkiye, these findings could lead to more comprehensive molecular characterization and epidemiological investigations. Although BEVs are not routinely prioritized in diagnostic screening panels for cattle, the incidental detection of cytopathogenic BEV isolates, together with the high seropositivity rate observed among in-contact animals, suggests that BEVs should be considered in virological investigations.

Methods and results For analysis, rectal and nasal swab samples were taken from 4 cattle showing mild respiratory symptoms on a farm, as well as blood samples from a total of 42 animals, including those that showed signs of contact. The cytopathogenic effect was detected in the Madin-Darby bovine kidney (MDBK) cell line by cultivation of fecal specimens. Two isolates were obtained and subjected to physicochemical characterization and determination of nucleic acid type. The fecal isolates were analyzed by RT-PCR using specific primers for possible key pathogens. The isolates showed resistance to chloroform and BrdU treatment, findings consistent with the characteristics of non-enveloped RNA viruses. Both isolates were positive in bovine enterovirus RT-PCR, and the molecular genetic analysis of the partial 5’UTR region of one of the isolates indicated that it belonged to the BEV-F clade. All 42 serum samples showed neutralizing activity at a dilution of ≥ 1:640 against the isolate used in the VNT. Conclusion This study, based on partial 5′UTR sequence analysis, provides preliminary molecular evidence of a bovine enterovirus associated with EV-F in Türkiye. Given the limited number of studies conducted in Türkiye, these findings could lead to more comprehensive molecular characterization and epidemiological investigations. Although BEVs are not routinely prioritized in diagnostic screening panels for cattle, the incidental detection of cytopathogenic BEV isolates, together with the high seropositivity rate observed among in-contact animals, suggests that BEVs should be considered in virological investigations.
